zones.message: frontend/ must not import backend/ — server-only code (Prisma, API keys, LLM calls) would leak into the client bundle. Fetch from an API route instead.
backend/ must not import frontend/ — backend code has no business depending on React/UI code.

patterns.message: Pages/layouts in this project are client components — import backend/ only inside app/api/**/route.ts, never directly from a page.
